description: Returns a short description of AskY's personal reading (a reading written by the reader herself for one question and sent by email, for adults aged 18 and over) and the address of the page that explains it. Use only when someone asks about a reading written personally for them. Nothing is booked or paid for in the conversation; this tool only returns information and a link.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" for English, "es" for Spanish. Use the language the person is writing in. Defaults to English.

name: get_personal_reading_info
title: Personal reading
